doc.title: Red Holloway interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995

title: Closing thanks
summary: The interviewers and Holloway thank each other and discuss the next day's plans.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: That’s great. We want to thank Red Holloway for sharing all these great thoughts with us, and, you said some things today that I think ought to be written down and recited to some of our — some great, great quotes.

Well thank you very much. But these are, as I see them. And thank you for having me, and I do thank you very, very, very much, and I do hope to see you all again sometime soon, just in your own colleges or universities, just as a visitor or whatever.
We’ll be listening tomorrow morning to you too.
Oh my goodness, I’d better get a good night’s sleep tonight.
Well most of our interviews will be over and we’re just going to come tomorrow just to listen.
Oh, okay then, that’s beautiful. And I want to thank you very much.
